# nflxso.net
> Netflix Support provides help articles, troubleshooting steps, account guidance, and service information for Netflix members.

This site is the primary support and help center for Netflix, covering account management, billing, devices, streaming issues, parental controls, accessibility, and contact options.

## Help Center Home
- [Netflix Help Center](https://help.netflix.com/): Main support portal for browsing articles, troubleshooting topics, and service information.
- [Contact Us](https://help.netflix.com/contactus): Support contact options for account, billing, and technical issues.
- [Request TV Shows or Movies](https://help.netflix.com/titlerequest): Submit suggestions for titles you want added to Netflix.
- [Media Center](https://media.netflix.com/): Official Netflix newsroom with company announcements, assets, and press resources.

## Account & Membership
- [How to sign up for Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/412): Steps for creating a Netflix account and starting a membership.
- [How to change your Netflix plan](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/22): Instructions for switching between available Netflix subscription plans.
- [How to cancel Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/407): Guidance for ending a membership and understanding cancellation timing.
- [How to restart your Netflix account](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/16282): Steps to resume a canceled Netflix membership.
- [Netflix says 'Your account is in use on another device'](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/29): Help resolving account access and simultaneous stream issues.
- [How to keep your account secure](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/13243): Best practices for passwords, phishing awareness, and account protection.

## Billing & Payments
- [Billing and Payments](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/116380): Overview of payment methods, billing dates, and charge management.
- [How to update payment information](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/116380#update-payment): Steps for changing your payment method on Netflix.
- [Understanding Netflix charges](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/116380#charges): Explanation of recurring charges and billing-related questions.
- [Gift Cards](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/32950): Information about redeeming and using Netflix gift cards.
- [Netflix billing through a partner](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/24853): Help for memberships billed through third-party providers.
- [How to find your billing date](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/407#billing-date): Guidance on locating your next Netflix billing date.

## Watching Netflix
- [How to watch Netflix on your TV](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14361): Setup and viewing instructions for watching Netflix on televisions.
- [How to watch Netflix on your computer or TV browser](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/1894): Browser requirements and playback guidance for web viewing.
- [How to download titles to watch offline](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/54816): Instructions for downloading supported content on compatible devices.
- [How to use subtitles, captions, or alternate audio](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/372): Accessibility and language options during playback.
- [How to create and edit profiles](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/10421): Manage profiles for different viewers on one account.
- [How to set up or update a Netflix Household](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/128339): Information about Netflix Household setup and management.

## Devices & Setup
- [Netflix supported devices](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14361#devices): Overview of device categories that can stream Netflix.
- [Using Netflix on your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/116367): Setup and troubleshooting for Netflix on Apple mobile devices.
- [Using Netflix on your Android phone or tablet](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/57688): App installation, playback, and troubleshooting for Android devices.
- [Using Netflix on smart TVs and streaming media players](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14361): General setup help for TVs and connected streaming devices.
- [Using Netflix on game consoles](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/23888): Guidance for streaming Netflix on supported gaming systems.
- [Using Netflix on set-top boxes and Blu-ray players](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14361#other-devices): Help for additional home entertainment devices.

## Troubleshooting
- [Netflix freezes, stops responding, or gets stuck loading](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/11639): Troubleshooting steps for loading and playback stalls.
- [Netflix isn't working](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/11639#not-working): General troubleshooting for app and streaming failures.
- [Black screen with sound](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/95): Fixes for video display issues when audio still plays.
- [Netflix says 'Cannot connect to Netflix'](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14424): Network and connectivity troubleshooting for connection errors.
- [Netflix says 'We're having trouble playing this title right now'](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/14424#play-title): Steps to resolve title playback errors.
- [How to update the Netflix app](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/116380#app-update): Guidance for getting the latest Netflix app version.

## Parental Controls & Safety
- [How to create kids profiles](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/264): Set up child-friendly profiles with age-appropriate content restrictions.
- [How to set maturity ratings or block titles](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/114276): Configure profile-level viewing restrictions and title blocks.
- [How to use a profile lock PIN](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/114277): Protect profiles with a PIN to limit unauthorized access.
- [Parental controls on Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/264#parental-controls): Overview of available parental control features.
- [How to review viewing activity](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/101917): Check watch history for profiles on your account.
- [How to report a show or movie](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/104515): Report content issues or concerns related to titles.

## Accessibility & Language
- [Accessibility on Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/25079): Overview of accessibility features available across Netflix devices.
- [Audio descriptions on Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/25079#audio-description): Information about narrated audio tracks for supported titles.
- [Subtitles and captions on Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/372): Help using subtitle and closed caption features.
- [How to change language on Netflix](https://help.netflix.com/en/node/13245): Update display and audio language preferences for your account.
- [Netflix in different languages](https://help.netflix.com/en/): Access localized help content in supported languages.

## Policies & Service Information
- [Terms of Use](https://help.netflix.com/legal/termsofuse): Legal terms governing use of the Netflix service.
- [Privacy Statement](https://help.netflix.com/legal/privacy): Details on how Netflix collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Cookie Preferences](https://help.netflix.com/legal/privacy#cookies): Information about cookies and related privacy controls.
- [Corporate Information](https://help.netflix.com/legal/corpinfo): Company and corporate entity information for Netflix.
- [Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information](https://help.netflix.com/legal/privacy#do-not-sell): Privacy rights information for eligible users.
- [Ad Choices](https://help.netflix.com/legal/adchoices): Information about advertising-related choices and disclosures.
